description_en: Authorizes a user to manage databases and database accounts
description_zh: 为用户授权数据库及数据库账户
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost attach-database-accounts-to-user --instance-id bastionhost-cn-wwo36qbv601 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --user-id 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachDatabaseAccountsToUser

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host whose user you want to grant permissions.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the ID of the bastion host
parameters.help_zh:
指定要授权数据库和数据库账户的用户所在堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the user to be authorized.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204522.html operation to query the user ID
parameters.help_zh:
要授权的用户ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204522.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: user_id

fields.help_en: An array that consists of database account IDs
fields.name: database_account_ids

fields.help_en: The ID of the database that you want to authorize the user to manage
fields.help_zh: 要授权的数据库实例 ID
fields.name: database_id

parameters.help_en:
An array that consists of database objects.

You can specify up to 10 databases and 10 database accounts. The database accounts are not required. If you do not specify a database account, the user is authorized to manage only the databases
parameters.help_zh:
数据库对象数组。
最大数据库数10个，数据库账号数10个。允许不传账号，不传账号则代表授权到数据库
parameters.name: databases

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Code.description_en: The error code that is returned. If OK is returned, the authorization was successful. If another error code is returned, the authorization failed
Code.description_zh: 错误码。错误码为OK时，表示授权成功；其他错误码表示授权失败

DatabaseAccounts.description_en: A list that shows the authorization results of the database accounts
DatabaseAccounts.description_zh: 数据库账号信息的列表

Code.description_en: The error code that is returned. If OK is returned, the authorization was successful. If another error code is returned, the authorization failed
Code.description_zh: 错误码。错误码为OK时，表示授权成功；其他错误码表示授权失败

The error message that is returned
